Bitmap Images concentrate on each pixel's color. (eg. "pixel 242LX is this color")
Vector images concentrate on shapes. (eg. "blue circle this big here")

Flash is vector. MS paint as well as most other standard image programs use bitmap, the standard.

      When all the matter and energy and whatever else gets sucked up into this singular point in existance (of course, we'll all be long dead), there will be another big bang, with insane amounts of intertia resulting in the amazing expansion of the universe. But again, at one point then, the universe will once again being to compact into the singular point in space-time.

      Around and around we go!

      There's been alot of talk and debate about human rights in this thread.

      I thought I should point out The Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Don't squabble about what rights humans do or do not have, this document is considered by most to be the most accurate tangible document on the issue.

      Quote: Article 16
      Men and women of full age, without any limitation due to race, nationality or religion, have the right to marry and to found a family. They are entitled to equal rights as to marriage, during marriage and at its dissolution.

      According to the UN, religion has no say in who may or may not get married. Marriage is no longer a religious issue.

      This article says nothing about gender, it says nothing about same-sex couples, but it doesn't say anything about opposite-sex couples, either. However:

      Quote: Article 2
      Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status. Furthermore, no distinction shall be made on the basis of the political, jurisdictional or international status of the country or territory to which a person belongs, whether it be independent, trust, non-self-governing or under any other limitation of sovereignty.

      And LSP is a layered service provider. They're small "programmish things" that form a barrier between your computer and the internet. Any internet activity passes through these programs, and the signal may be altered at will by them. Most of the time, LSPs are good things, but in the case of the ones I want to remove, they are not.

      A DLL is a program extention, little extra bit of code that are not in an .exe file. LSPs are in the form of DLLs, refrenced by Windows.
